module.title: Domain
module.description: Domain setup, domain controllers, FSMO roles and directory administration.

perm.info-read: View domain information, DCs, FSMO roles and levels

os-support.fail: {{os}} is not supported for a domain controller.
os-support.fix: Use Debian 12 (with backports), Debian 13 or Ubuntu 24.04/26.04.

samba-version.fail: Samba {{version}} is older than the required {{min}} (or not available).
samba-version.fix: Enable a repository that provides Samba {{min}} or later (Debian 12: bookworm-backports).

not-provisioned.fail: A Samba domain database already exists ({{path}}).
not-provisioned.fix: Use a fresh host, or remove the old Samba installation completely.

hostname.fail: Host name "{{host}}" is not usable for a DC ({{issue}}).
hostname.fix: Use 1–15 letters, digits or hyphens, not only digits and not a reserved name.

fqdn-domain.warn: The domain {{domain}} ends in .local, which clashes with multicast DNS (mDNS) on clients.
fqdn-domain.fail: {{fqdn}} must be <host>.{{domain}}, and the domain must be a valid DNS name with at least two labels ({{issue}}).
fqdn-domain.fix: Choose a domain you own (e.g. ad.example.com) and name the host <host>.<domain>.

netbios.fail: NetBIOS domain name "{{netbios}}" is not usable ({{issue}}).
netbios.fix: Use at most 15 letters, digits or hyphens, different from the host name.

ip-assigned.fail: {{ip}} is not configured on any interface (found: {{found}}).
ip-assigned.fix: Configure the static address first, or choose one of the listed addresses.

ip-static.warn: {{ip}} on {{iface}} was assigned by DHCP. A DC needs an address that never changes.
ip-static.fix: Configure a static address, or a DHCP reservation that never changes.

port-53.warn: Port 53 is used by the local stub resolver ({{processes}}); setup will disable it.
port-53.fix: Stop and disable the other DNS server; the DC provides DNS for the domain.

ports.pass: The ports of a domain controller are free.
ports.fail: Ports needed by the DC are in use: {{ports}}.
ports.fix: Stop the listed services (another LDAP, Kerberos or SMB server) before setup.

disk.warn: Only {{free}} GiB free on {{path}}; 5 GiB or more is recommended.
disk.fail: Only {{free}} GiB free on {{path}}; at least 2 GiB are needed.
disk.fix: Free disk space or enlarge the volume.

filesystem.pass: {{path}} is on {{type}} (extended attributes and ACLs supported).
filesystem.warn: {{path}} is on {{type}}; Samba needs extended attributes and POSIX ACLs.
filesystem.fix: Put /var/lib/samba on ext4, XFS, Btrfs or ZFS.

memory.warn: {{memory}} GiB memory; 2 GiB or more is recommended for a DC.
memory.fail: {{memory}} GiB memory is too little for a DC.
memory.fix: Give the host at least 2 GiB of memory.

mac.warn: SELinux is active; the distribution's Samba DC policy may block the DC.
mac.fix: Check the SELinux audit log after setup, or use container mode.

time.pass: The clock is synchronised (offset {{offset}} s from {{reference}}).
time.warn: The clock is not synchronised (offset {{offset}} s). Kerberos fails beyond 5 minutes of skew.
time.fix: Check chrony: chronyc tracking; allow outbound NTP (UDP 123).

dns-forwarder.warn: Upstream DNS {{servers}} doesn't answer; the domain can't resolve Internet names until it does.
dns-forwarder.fix: Enter reachable DNS servers (e.g. your router or provider) as forwarders.

dc-reachable.fail: Domain controller {{dc}} is not reachable on port(s) {{ports}}.
dc-reachable.fix: Check the address, routing and firewalls between this host and {{dc}}.

dc-dns.fail: {{dc}} doesn't resolve _ldap._tcp.{{domain}}; it is not a DC of that domain or DNS is broken.
dc-dns.fix: Enter the address of a DC of {{domain}} and check its DNS service.

dc-time.pass: The clock differs from {{dc}} by {{offset}} s.
dc-time.warn: The clock differs from {{dc}} by {{offset}} s (or {{dc}} doesn't answer NTP).
dc-time.fail: The clock differs from {{dc}} by {{offset}} s; Kerberos allows at most 5 minutes.
dc-time.fix: Synchronise both hosts with chrony before joining.
